isotropic_noise.qualification: Isotropic noise is in observed Y coordinates; target-dependent variances cancel because every full permutation uses every target exactly once.

symmetric_perturbations.qualification: The 1*mean(epsilon) bound is for C_Qhat-C_Q, or equal known-floor subtraction. Re-estimating both minimum-eigenvalue floors gives the general 2*mean(epsilon) bound by Weyl.

smooth_empirical_width.equality_reason: Cauchy-Schwarz gives mean(exp(p/tau))*mean(exp(-p/tau))>=1, with equality iff all p_k coincide, for finite tau>0.
smooth_empirical_width.qualification: This is empirical width: a zero identifies constancy only on the finite observed samples, not the whole population support.

active_assignment_descent.qualification: At each current W choose an active minimizing assignment, then contract each signed angle to its assigned normal. This verifies a descent direction on the product of unit spheres. It is not a claim that a fixed-initial-assignment upper bound makes the entire reoptimized loss path monotone.
